message.content: {"brief_rationale":"The trajectory ultimately moved the family from reluctance to urgent inpatient clarification, surgery, postoperative monitoring, and a concrete written follow-up plan. However, RC3 screening was incomplete before the procedure and RC5’s direct explanation of debridement was too vague, creating minor responsibility-chain errors that cap the grade at 2. The doctor also invented unsupported postoperative timelines such as “至少2-4周” of immobilization and “术后3-5天” assessment, although later advice appropriately deferred weight-bearing decisions to the treating team.
